pattern.short_summary: The interaction surface is a vertically scrolling transcript of alternating turns with a persistent composition area anchored below it.
pattern.definition: The interaction surface is a vertically scrolling transcript of alternating turns with a persistent composition area anchored below it. The transcript is the record and the display at once: earlier turns remain addressable by scrolling, and new turns append to the end. Nothing about the layout is specialized to the task; the same surface would serve any turn-taking exchange.
pattern.structural_signature: Two regions: an append-only scrollable list of turn elements attributed to a speaker, and a fixed input region containing a text field plus a send affordance. New content enters at one end; the viewport auto-follows or can be scrolled back; history persists in the same region it was produced in. This is fully statable without reference to what the turns are about, which is precisely why it recurs across unrelated domains.
